lines.say: Most systems keep this policy fixed. To test a new one, they must run a full new search.

lines.say: Dream R S I keeps every past attempt and its score in a discovery tree. The tree becomes a replay simulator.
lines.text: Dream-RSI keeps every past attempt and its score in a discovery tree. The tree becomes a replay simulator.

lines.say: A new policy can replay the old tree. The tree already holds every result, so the test needs no new runs.
lines.text: A new policy can replay the old tree. The tree already holds every result, so the test needs no new runs.

lines.say: The paper calls this dreaming. A second agent rewrites the policy many times inside the dream.

lines.say: The best version returns to the real search. Its new attempts grow the tree for the next dream.

lines.say: On a Lasso solver, it used three hundred seventeen attempts where a fixed policy used five hundred fifty. Its code also ran faster.
